LanguageData.BOR_Trot.label: trot
LanguageData.BOR_Trot.description:
A performance-enhancing demi-steroid originally developed to combat Carpal Tunnel Syndrome. Trot almost entirely negates pain while instilling an Adrenal reaction which increases the user's movement speed and improves their combat abilities.
The compound is Addictive, though lax quality control and loose drug regulations within Kwazaari sectors see the substance prolifically used all over the stars.
